_comment: The only place plans, prices and limits are written for the site. Limits are copied from the backend seed (Centcom-backend packages/db/migrations/20260102001500_plans_entitlements.sql, table plan_limits); the server is the source of truth and a human must re-check them before launch. No price is defined anywhere in the plan, contracts or backend code, so every paid price is TBD: status "tbd" has no amount. When a price is decided set status to "known" with amountMinor (integer minor units, CT-IDS: 1900 = 19.00) and currency USD or EUR.
